description: This file contains functions for loading schema JSON files related to a presentation builder frontend, including functions to fetch wizard schema and template models, as well as a utility to build lookup maps for layouts, slides, and placeholders.

methods.name: loadWizardSchema()
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the wizard schema JSON from a public assets path, parsing and returning the JSON data. Throws an error if the fetch fails.

methods.name: loadTemplateModel()
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the PPT normalized template model JSON, parsing and returning the data. Throws an error if the fetch fails.

methods.name: buildTemplateIndex(templateModel)
methods.description: Constructs lookup maps for layouts, slides, and placeholders from the provided template model, facilitating quick data access.
